marketing.pricing.heading: Simple, transparent pricing

marketing.pricing.saveUpTo: Save up to 20% on annual billing
marketing.pricing.taxNote: Taxes calculated at checkout based on your billing address and tax identification.
marketing.pricing.featureComparisonSubti: See which plan fits your platform requirements.
marketing.pricing.faq.trial.q: How does the 14-day free trial work?
marketing.pricing.faq.trial.a: You can test all features of your chosen plan for 14 days without charge. You can cancel at any time during the trial with zero cost.
marketing.pricing.faq.changePlan.q: Can I change my plan later?
marketing.pricing.faq.changePlan.a: Yes. You can upgrade, downgrade, or switch between monthly and annual intervals at any time directly through the billing centre in your admin console.
marketing.pricing.faq.tax.q: How is sales tax or VAT handled?
marketing.pricing.faq.tax.a: Tax is calculated at checkout based on your country and jurisdiction. Registered businesses can input their VAT or tax ID to apply reverse charges where applicable.
marketing.pricing.faq.payment.q: What payment methods do you accept?
marketing.pricing.faq.payment.a: We accept major credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), Apple Pay, Google Pay, and localized payment methods via Stripe.

marketing.status.metaDescription: Live system status for Sanvi, with incident history.
marketing.status.heading: System status
marketing.status.lead: Live service state, read from the same readiness signal our operators act on.
marketing.status.operational.title: All services operational
marketing.status.degraded.title: Some services are degraded
marketing.status.degraded.description: Affected: {checks}. Core actions still work; anything touching a degraded dependency may be slow or temporarily unavailable.
marketing.status.unknown.title: Live status is unreachable
marketing.status.unknown.description: This page could not reach the status signal, so it shows the last known state rather than an error. Your data is safe.
marketing.status.hostingLimitation: This status page is served by the same infrastructure it reports on, so a full outage may make this page itself unavailable. It always degrades to its last known state rather than to an error.
marketing.status.checks.heading: Dependencies
marketing.status.incidents.heading: Incident history
marketing.status.incident.storefront-rea: Storefront reads are slow or failing
Browsing storefronts may be slow. Checkout and admin writes are unaffected.
marketing.status.incident.admin-write.ti: Admin writes are slow or failing
marketing.status.incident.admin-write.bo: Saving in the admin console may be slow. Browsing storefronts is unaffected.
marketing.status.incident.checkout-creat: Starting a checkout may fail. Completed payments are unaffected and never charged twice.
marketing.status.incident.webhook-proces: Provider webhooks are queued and will be applied in order. Nothing is lost.
marketing.status.incident.conversion-upl: Conversion events are queued with their consent snapshot and will upload when the ad platforms recover.
marketing.status.incident.domain-issuanc: New custom domains stay pending while issuance is degraded. Live domains are unaffected.
